item.text: The campaign is live and eligible to serve. It has one line item capped at $700 total, $78/day, with the approved posts targeting iOS and Android users in the US and Canada. I’m starting the first performance check now; the campaign’s end time is set to midnight Eastern after Oct 31.

At the first full day check, the campaign has delivered 63,529 impressions, 34 link clicks, and $76.66 in spend. Both approved posts are producing clicks at nearly the same rate, so there’s no evidence yet to cut either one. I’ll keep both live and continue monitoring daily.

item.text: As of the start of Halloween, the campaign has spent about $610 and generated 289 link clicks across 622,753 impressions. Delivery is steady and remains within the approved total cap. It’s still live for the final day, with both posts running.

The nine day campaign ran Oct 23–31 in Eastern time and has ended.

- **Spend:** $687.30 of the $700 budget
- **Impressions:** 678,335
